meta.source_note: AR FY25 + BSE 21-May-2025 results + BSE 08-Aug-2025 investor deck + BSE 29-Jan-2026 Q3/Bonus + screener.in/company/CUPID (23 Sep 2026 close)

peers_sfb.pot_label: FY25 sexual wellness + diagnostics pot ~₹18,500 Cr (listed peers only)

peers.overlap: Manforce condoms leader — scale + distribution benchmark

families.name: Male Condoms
families.desc: Latex condoms — flavours, colours, ultra-thin 50 microns, 100% electronic testing. 64% of FY25 revenue. WHO/UNFPA + USFDA 510(k) + CE.

families.name: Female Condoms
families.desc: Latex FC-1 / Cupid Angel — cost-effective dual protection vs STI + pregnancy. Only Indian maker, 15% FY25 (~₹27.5 Cr). Palava +75M coming.

families.name: Water-based Lubricant Jelly
families.desc: 4.5ml sachets + tubes + bottles, CE self-certified (additional CE in progress). Exported to 30+ countries. Lubricants + condoms resumed with UNFPA FY26.

families.name: IVD Kits
families.desc: 15 kits — Cupikit/Cupisure: HIV, Syphilis, Pregnancy, Hepatitis B, Malaria, Typhoid, Dengue. CE for 4 kits advanced + WHO malaria PQ expected. 14% FY25 (~₹25.7 Cr), PAT positive.

families.name: Deodorants & Perfumes
families.desc: EDPs, deodorants, pocket perfumes — launched Mar-24, expanded FY25. Part of B2C basket that crossed ₹50 Cr FY25 → target ₹125 Cr FY26.

families.name: Personal Care & Wellness
families.desc: Almond hair oil, body/massage oils, petroleum jelly, face wash, hair removal sprays — new launches FY25. Science + empathy + innovation.

extras.name: Menstrual & Hygiene Care
extras.desc: Menstrual cups, toilet seat sanitizers, bath oils — hygiene adjacency, chemist channel expansion.

extras.name: Distribution & E-commerce
extras.desc: 1,20,000+ touchpoints (target 1.8L FY26), 55+ super stockists, 850+ distributors — Amazon, Flipkart, BigBasket, 1mg, Blinkit, Zepto.

extras.name: Palava Expansion
extras.desc: 170K sq ft Palava plant (₹ lineage) — +770M male +75M female capacity → total 1.25B male +125M female at full ramp.

financial_snapshot.note: TTM to 23 Sep 2026 — hyper-growth vs hyper-multiple: TTM total income ~₹322 Cr (+59% vs FY25) on 22.7% EBITDA margin. Net cash ~₹68 Cr, almost debt-free.

vision.quote: We remain comfortably capitalized and are ready for the next era of profitable growth — spurred by our strong international business along with our cost-effective foray into India's B2C FMCG space.
vision.quote_source: Aditya Kumar Halwasiya, Chairman & MD, BSE Press Release 21-May-2025 (FY25 results) & Investor Deck Aug-2025. The filings frame it as 'building enduring consumer brands, grounded in science, built with empathy, and scaled with innovation.'

pillars.label: B2B international depth
pillars.text: Institutional + tender + OEM private label in 125+ countries. First co globally with WHO/UNFPA prequalification for both male & female condoms. Lubricants fully resumed with UNFPA from FY26.

pillars.label: B2C India scale
pillars.text: B2C FMCG crossed ₹50 Cr FY25 (14% of revenue) → target ₹125 Cr FY26 → ₹122 Cr consumer FY26 est. 1.2L touchpoints → 1.8L FY26 via GT + chemists + MT + quick commerce.

pillars.label: Certifications → market access
pillars.text: CE Mark for 4 IVD kits (HIV, Syphilis, Pregnancy, Hep B) advanced; WHO PQ for Malaria kit expected; additional CE for lubricants; Brown Caramel FC prequalified, V3 Ring FC in progress.

pillars.label: Capacity ahead of demand
pillars.text: Palava greenfield +70% capacity (Sinnar 480M→1.25B male, 52M→125M female). Nitrile platform — premium latex-free female condom for $1.2B+ global market by 2030.

vision.oneline: Cupid makes intimacy safe and diagnostics accessible where public health is non-negotiable — 'science + empathy + innovation' is the product promise; '125 countries + 1.2L Indian outlets' is the distribution promise.

valuation.methodology: TTM PAT ~₹83.5 Cr on 134.47 Cr shares (post 4:1 bonus Mar-2026, FV ₹1) → EPS ~₹0.62 · P/E ~441× at ₹273.85. DCF 10Y fade 14%→6%, WACC 10.5% (Rf 6.8% ERP 6% Beta 1.1) terminal 6%, net cash +₹68 Cr. Fwd P/E 30× on FY27E EPS ₹2.83 (₹380 Cr PAT on ₹725 Cr rev at 29% guide mid). EV/EBITDA 35×. Blended = equal-weight. *FY27E EPS shown bonus-adjusted; pre-bonus equivalent ₹14.15. Shares 134.47 Cr, face ₹1.

trends.title: Institutional resumption + global tenders
trends.body: 9M FY26 op revenue ₹237.7 Cr (+87% YoY) vs FY25 ₹183.5 Cr — full clearance of Cupid lubricants by UNFPA, sizeable condoms + lubricants resumption from FY26, plus WHO/UNFPA tenders (Tanzania ₹42 Cr Feb-2025). Exports 48% FY25.
trends.cta: → Watch UNFPA order flow + tender wins

trends.title: 1 lakh → 1.8 lakh touchpoints
trends.body: B2C FMCG ₹50 Cr FY25 → ₹125 Cr FY26 guide (+150%) — 55 super stockists, 850 distributors, 25k chemists → 1L+ targeted, Amazon/Flipkart/BigBasket/1mg + Blinkit/Zepto. Consumer biz ₹122 Cr FY26 est. incl. ₹84 Cr FMCG.

trends.title: 15-kit IVD now PAT positive
trends.body: IVD ₹25.7 Cr FY25 (14%) from ~₹5 Cr FY23 — 6 states → pan-India FY26, exports to Tanzania/Liberia/Ghana/Nepal/Philippines, 10+ registrations pipeline. CE for 4 kits + WHO Malaria PQ are near-term catalysts.

trends.title: 550% in 1Y — PE 440× prices FY27 perfection
trends.body: Price ₹43 (adj) → ₹274 (+550% 1Y, 52W 32.87–299), MCap ~₹36,800 Cr. 4:1 bonus Mar-2026 + BSE Group A + FTSE EM All Cap Sep-21-2026. Top decile momentum — 10/15 months double-digit gains, Dec-2025 +57.5% best month.

trends.title: Palava + nitrile — latex-free upside
trends.body: Palava 170K sq ft commissioning next quarter → 1.25B male +125M female at full capacity (was 480M +52M). Premium latex-free nitrile female condom in dev. for $1.2B+ global market by 2030 — first-mover if WHO-prequalified.

big_messages.label: Growth
big_messages.text: “We are ready for the next era of profitable growth — ₹335 Cr FY26 → ₹725–750 Cr FY27 → ₹1,085 Cr FY28 → ₹1,500 Cr FY29 is the guide. International + B2C FMCG both engines firing.”

big_messages.label: Institutional trust
big_messages.text: “First company globally with WHO/UNFPA prequalification for both male & female condoms — full resumption of lubricants + condoms business with UNFPA from FY26.”

big_messages.label: Capital allocation
big_messages.text: “4:1 bonus Mar-2026 to broaden retail participation + BSE Group A + FTSE EM All Cap — comfort-capitalized, dividend-light, reinvest for Palava + brand building.”

flags.evidence: P/E ~440× TTM (₹274 / ₹0.62 EPS post-bonus) · P/S ~115× · 550% 1Y · prices FY27 PAT ₹210–225 Cr perfection; any guide slip derates multiple
FY26 ₹335 Cr (+83%) → FY27 ₹725 Cr (+116%) step is 2× FY25 revenue; 9M FY26 ₹237.7 Cr leaves ₹97 Cr Q4 to hit FY26; FY27 needs 2.2× scale
GT scaling 1L→1.8L outlets + QC/warehousing + EDP/deo inventory; Q1 EBITDA margin 27.5% vs FY25 22.7% — promo + receivables risk as FMCG mix climbs to 34% (₹125/₹335)
48% exports + UNFPA/tender dependence (Tanzania ₹42 Cr order Feb-25); order cover not disclosed; FX + tariff + WHO funding cycle volatility
Promoter 46.2% Jun-26, pledge 8.03% of promoter (was 40–46% Jun-24/Mar-25, down sharply). Still watch pledging alongside capacity capex

bottom_line.core_idea: Not a commodity rubber factory — WHO-grade sexual wellness + diagnostics sold to 125 countries + 1L Indian outlets.
bottom_line.what_changed: Domestic B2C 14% → 34% FY26E + UNFPA resumption → 9M op revenue +87% hyper-growth.
bottom_line.hidden_insight: Watch 440× → 40× derate path — EPS must 5× before multiple compresses; price spread is multiple, not just earnings.
bottom_line.what_breaks: FY27 guide miss (₹725C) + Palava delay + FMCG promo overshoot → margin + multiple both compress.
bottom_line.open_question: Can Cupid land ₹210–225 Cr PAT on ₹725 Cr (29% margin) while scaling GT 1.8L outlets and Palava?
bottom_line.takeaway: Don't chase 440× — own the WHO moat, wait for execution price.

forecast.note: Shares flat at ~134.47 Cr post 4:1 bonus (Mar-2026, FV ₹1) — net cash +₹68 Cr, no dilution assumed (Bull 60% CAGR may need working capital). Bear = tender deferral + B2C promo drag + derate to 45×. Bull = Palava ramp + nitrile WHO + B2C 1.8L velocity, P/E held 80×. Even Bull derates from 440× → 80×; earnings must 10× to offset.

takeaway: Cupid doesn't sell rubbers — it sells certainty in intimate health where failure is not an option, and the filings say the next chapter is WHO-prequalified condoms + lubricants resumption + B2C FMCG at 1.8L outlets + Palava 1.25B capacity — WHO-certified in Nashik, built for 125 countries, scaling for India.
